matches.label: title_block
matches.part_summary: A rectangular mounting bracket or clamp block with counterbored through-holes, elongated rectangular slots on the front face, and flanged edges, finished with chemical conversion coating per MIL-DTL-5541F A symmetric mounting bracket or housing with two rectangular recessed pockets, four tapped through-holes for #4-40 helical inserts, and mounting bosses on each end, shown with three cross-sections detailing internal wall profiles and hole geometry.
